causal_tests.remove_all_learned_non_chain_productions: candidate-only non-chain heldout matches must fall to zero
causal_tests.remove_each_candidate_only_tool: that exact tool digest must lose all of its heldout matches
causal_tests.shuffle_topology_output_indices: both implementations must reject or change the production digest

decision_rule.infrastructure_failure: enumerators disagree, authenticated split changes, any graph cannot be accounted for, hostile tests fail, or resource limits fail
decision_rule.positive: at least one learned non-chain production constructs an exact training tool that transfers to heldout and covers at least one node unreachable by both controls; all causal, independent, hostile, and resource gates pass
decision_rule.valid_negative: the complete bounded search and all gates pass but the positive endpoint is not reached

heldout_rule.candidate_cost: all training subsets visited + learned production structural units + learned tool structural units + heldout subsets visited
heldout_rule.chain_control_cost: all training chain subsets visited + learned chain-tool structural units + heldout chain subsets visited
heldout_rule.coverage: unique heldout graph call_function node identities participating in at least one exact match
heldout_rule.match: byte-identical canonical exact tool body learned from training, under a selected training topology production

native_dedup_rule.classification: compile each candidate-only exact tool and its inlined reference under the existing native-dedup receipt contract

primary_endpoints.candidate_only_heldout_nodes: heldout nodes covered by candidate matches but neither control
primary_endpoints.candidate_only_heldout_tools: exact candidate tools with heldout matches and no exact chain-control or supplied-fixed target-sequence equivalent
primary_endpoints.learned_multi_output_productions: count selected productions with more than one output
primary_endpoints.learned_non_chain_productions: count selected productions not satisfying fixed_chain

training_rule.exact_tool_description_length_gain: occurrences * (nodes + typed_inputs + outputs) - ((nodes + typed_inputs + outputs) + occurrences)
training_rule.topology_description_length_gain: occurrences * (node_count + edge_count + output_count) - ((node_count + edge_count + output_count) + occurrences)

universal_typed_dag_metalanguage.eligible_node: torch.fx call_function node whose target starts with aten. and whose meta val is a typed Tensor
universal_typed_dag_metalanguage.inputs: all typed tensor dependencies from outside the subset, first-use ordered; supported literals retain exact values
universal_typed_dag_metalanguage.outputs: every internal node with any user outside the subset, ordered by parent graph order
universal_typed_dag_metalanguage.subgraph: every unique node subset whose undirected induced dependency graph is connected

topology_production.external_input_uses: per node count of direct external typed-tensor dependencies
topology_production.fixed_chain: one output at final index and internal edges exactly [[0,1],[1,2],...]
topology_production.internal_edges: sorted [producer_index, consumer_index] pairs for all internal tensor dependencies
